itinerary.title: Arrival HCM - Transfer to Dalat
activities: Suggested arrival time: 12pm or earlier
Arrive Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) HCM
Land transfer to Da Lat (6-8 Hours drive)
Check In Hotel Dalat

itinerary.title: Dalat Fullday Tour
activities: Mongo Land (Rainbow Slide Included)
Flower Park (Largest flower park in Dalat)
Mei Linh Coffee Garden (Fresh coffee plantation taste)
Shopping Amee Wholesale (Fashion designer market)
Datanla Waterfall (Alpine coaster included)
Railway Station (Experience the thrill train path)
Return Hotel, Free & Easy

itinerary.title: Muine Fullday Tour
activities: Land transfer to Mui Nee (5 Hours drive)
White Sand Dunes (The only desert in Southeast Asia)
Red Sand Dunes (JEEP & ATV Activity @ Sand Dunes optional)
Fishing Village (Pristine beaches, vibrant fishing boats, and bustling markets)
Land transfer to HCM (3 Hours drive)
Stop by Gudang Shopping Telekung, Tudung etc.
Check in Hotel HCM.
Free & Easy - Shopping at Malaysia Street & Ben Thanh Market.

itinerary.title: HCM - Return KL
activities: Suggested departure time: 3pm & before
Free & Easy - Shopping Ben Thanh Market
Transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)

expect.title: Attraction Places
expect.body: Attraction places may require a long journey to reach, 3 to 8 hours on some days.

expect.title: Full Board Meals
expect.body: Meals are already included in the package. If you choose not to consume them, no refund will be provided.

expect.title: Lot of Walking
expect.body: Some attraction places will require a lot of walking.

expect.title: Hotel Locations
expect.body: Will prioritize near to city centre first. If not available, hotel location will be just outside the city center.

expect.title: Luggage Allocations
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage for 1 pax as it will affect the car capacity.
